title_zh: 为读书小组选择以回忆为线索的小说

scenario.goal_zh: 比较故事题材与讨论安排后选定共读作品

context_zh: 读书小组成员比较两本作品的题材和篇幅，选定下一次讨论用书。
author: author-phase04-a

sentences.speaker: Cora
sentences.text: Should we choose the detective story or this shorter novel for next month?

sentences.speaker: Miles
sentences.text: What is the shorter one about?

sentences.speaker: Cora
sentences.text: A woman returns to her childhood home. Her memory of one summer changes as she talks to old friends.

sentences.speaker: Miles
sentences.text: That sounds interesting. Is it mostly about her childhood, then?

sentences.speaker: Cora
sentences.text: Yes, and it is under two hundred pages. We should have plenty to discuss at our meeting on the sixth.

sentences.speaker: Miles
sentences.text: Let us choose that one. I will tell the group so everyone has time to find a copy.

targets.sense_zh: 对过去事情的记忆；回忆
